subject: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbusedge.com
Cc: Melissa Grant <melissa@acme-vendors.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge

Hi Monica / NimbusEdge team / Melissa,

We're ready to onboard NimbusEdge as a Tier 2 vendor for our telemetry ingestion connectors. Quick asks so Procurement/Finance can issue PO(s) and we can start charging: 

- Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (basic company info & payment terms).
- Requested spend cap: $120,000 for the first 12 months.
- We need line-item mapping by SKU so our billing can split usage between US infra and EU infra. Ideally two PO numbers: one for US spend, one for EU spend.
- Preferred billing cadence: monthly invoices net-30. Please confirm if NimbusEdge needs a consolidated PO or separate POs per region.

Melissa — can you attach your W9 and primary billing contact info? If you have vendor legal name variations or remit-to addresses, include them.

Monica — can you confirm the PO issuance flow and whether Finance needs any custom ledger coding? Marcus, looping you to propose the line-item split (we expect ~70% US / 30% EU initially).

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Melissa Grant <melissa@acme-vendors.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbusedge.com
Date: 2026-09-02T12:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge

Thanks Connor — quick reply from my side.

I've attached our W9 (W9_Melissa_Grant.pdf) and the remit-to address. Legal name is NimbusEdge, Inc. We can accept a single PO with region-level line items or two POs — whichever makes reconciliation easier for you. Our standard payment terms are net-30; we invoice monthly.

Billing contact: Melissa Grant, melissa@acme-vendors.com, +1 (415) 555-0198

A couple of notes: 
- If you issue two POs, please reference them both on our invoices so we know which ledger to apply.
- We prefer electronic payment (ACH).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Melissa Grant
Vendor Ops Lead, NimbusEdge

Attachments: W9_Melissa_Grant.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Grant <melissa@acme-vendors.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge

Thanks Connor and Melissa — got the onboarding form and W9.

Procurement prefers issuing two PO numbers for cross-regional clarity: one for US (PO-NX-20260902-001) and one for EU (PO-NX-20260902-002). That helps with tax & ledger separation.

Marcus — please prepare a line-item matrix that maps the expected SKUs and quantities (we'll start with estimate-based POs and convert to actual spend reconciliation monthly). I've attached a starter CSV (po_lineitem_matrix.csv) with suggested SKU buckets:
- NX-INGEST-US (ingestion capacity, billed per GB)
- NX-INGEST-EU
- NX-CONN-MGMT (connector management, flat monthly)

Laura — can Finance confirm whether the two POs should map to the following ledger codes? If not, suggest alternatives. We need PO issuance this week to meet Connor's launch window.

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachments: po_lineitem_matrix.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Melissa Grant <melissa@acme-vendors.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 8:45 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus — please prepare a line-item matrix that maps the expected SKUs and quantities...

Attached is my proposed split. Summary below: 

- PO-NX-20260902-001 (US) — Spend cap $84,000 (70% of requested cap)
  - NX-INGEST-US — estimate 420 GB/month @ $40/GB (initial quarter estimate)
  - NX-CONN-MGMT — flat $4,000/month

- PO-NX-20260902-002 (EU) — Spend cap $36,000 (30% of requested cap)
  - NX-INGEST-EU — estimate 180 GB/month @ $35/GB
  - NX-CONN-MGMT — flat $2,000/month (EU region fee)

I've added qty and unit price columns in the CSV. Melissa — please confirm these SKU names match your invoicing line items; if your invoice uses different descriptors we can map them during reconciliation.

If Finance confirms, we can issue provisional POs now and mark them as estimate-based, to be reconciled monthly.

- Marcus Lin
Pricing & Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachments: po_lineitem_matrix.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Grant <melissa@acme-vendors.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO setup for NimbusEdge

Thanks all — confirmed. Finance has created the two PO records and assigned ledger codes: 

- PO-NX-20260902-001 -> Ledger: EXP-INF-US (cost center 4201)
- PO-NX-20260902-002 -> Ledger: EXP-INF-EU (cost center 4202)

Both POs are provisional/estimate-based and include the spend caps Marcus outlined. Please note the following: 
- Invoices should reference the PO number and the SKU code column from Marcus' CSV. If an invoice references different descriptors, include a mapping table.
- Payment: ACH only (as vendor requested). Finance will send an ACH vendor onboarding form (separate DocuSign link).
- Procurement: please update the Purchase Log with these PO numbers: https://drive.redwood.com/PoLog/NX-2026-09

Melissa — we will issue the official PO PDFs to the remit-to address on file by EOD tomorrow. Let us know if you need consolidated billing instead of two POs.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Accounting Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

References: HubSpot deal HS-84621; DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Redwood/NX/vendor-contract-2026
